memory.physical_ram_upper_bound_evidence: Native ROM helper 0x8002caa0 constructs DMCR=0x059a0a0d and writes 0xb3010080 at 0x8002cab0. JZ4730 EMC primary manual pp.31-32 decodes BW=0,CA=1,RA=1,BA=1 => 32-bit,9 column,12 row,4 internal banks =>32MiB per populated chip select. No direct caller of this helper, bootloader, DMAR bank population, or hardware measurement established. 0x82000000 is the supported restricted address-window upper bound, not a claim that no other memory is populated.

validation.static: Exact raw C200knl payload: independently checked RTOS/heap seed, five exports and limits, old FIFO UDC/IRQ12, MSCR/OCR/SBA, active-low GP89, active-high PA29 output, LCD native geometry/descriptors. verified means static firmware binding; no hardware support claim.
validation.qemu: No JZ4730 board boot or USB host test in this task.
validation.firmware_version: GUI native draw at 0x800190cc references GBK version string at 0x80253888: V1.30; release string at 0x80253828 also identifies 9588v1.30. Recovery folder/package version is not used.
validation.usb_cable: GP89 bit25 of 0xb0010060 is active-low. Query 0x8002917c returns 1 for raw=0; wrapper 0x8002abf4 returns0x80; GUIUSB callers0x8001d86c/0x8001e3a8 invoke0x800189d8 only on nonzero. Board wiring was not physically measured.
validation.usb_pullup: Native connect0x8018ad10 sets PA29 DATA bit0x20000000; disconnect0x8018ad48 clears it. Board0x80004668..94 disables its IRQ, sets output, selectsGPIOfunction0, raisesDATA.
validation.usb_gpio_layout: JZ4730 GP89 DATA=b0010060, MASK(+24)=b0010084, W1CFLAG(+28)=b0010088. No 0x100 per-bank spacing or JZ4740 IMS/IMC aliases.
validation.usb_aux: None independently identified; disabled. PA24 in neighboring native code is SD-card-detect, not USB.
limitations: No physical USB enumeration, VBUS wiring, packet ACK timing, mass-storage recovery, or LCD color/orientation validation.
32MiB address window supported by native memory layout and SDRAM geometry helper; exact physical chip-select population/DMAR configuration not measured.

native_mips_model.scope: Native UDC init/IRQ12, active-low GP89 query and wrapper, PA29 board setup/connect/disconnect plus SBA, GP89 IRQ137 setup, actual LCD init/memset/descriptor/IRQ30 with two explicit clock/panel helper stubs.

lcd.orientation: Native LCD physical portrait; GUI can rotate independently. Snapshot uses LCD DMA source and physical width/height, not GUI logical geometry.
